ruling.recommended_action: Close the case: no off-route segment or overcharge found; note the fare-detail explanation to the rider and advise the driver nothing is owed.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider's claim that the driver took a longer route is contradicted by the system records: actual distance 8.8 km is 0.1 km shorter than the 8.9 km optimal route [F1] and the billed distance does not exceed it [F3]; no `gps-detour-*` segment exists. The higher-than-expected feel of the fare is explained by the metered distance/time components and heavy rain [F5][F13], not by any detour.

The driver's weather/traffic explanation is corroborated (heavy rain [F13], speed band 5 [F10][F11]), but RD-4 only excuses an existing off-route segment; since no deviation occurred [F1][F3], this claim is moot rather than the basis of the ruling.
